description: Run an existing local Gretl .inp script file with gretlcli. By default this also requires opening the same workflow in the visible Gretl GUI.

displayInGretl.description: Open the script file in the visible Gretl GUI after running. Defaults to true outside CI.

requireGui.description: Require the visible Gretl GUI to open for this workflow. Defaults to true outside CI.

safeMode.description: When true, validates the script before running it.

scriptOpt.description: Optional numeric value passed to Gretl as --scriptopt.

scriptPath.description: Path to an existing local Gretl .inp script.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the script. Defaults to the script file directory.

name: gretl_run_script_file
